corpus_state: post-DL-19. The run predates the commit of the Phase 5.5 corrections but not the corrections themselves: they were applied to the working tree, measured, then committed. Confirmed by pooled mrr of 0.674, which is DL-20's post-correction figure, against DL-18's pre-correction 0.723.
note: Retrieval quality with the RAW question as the query. Phase 6 replaces that input with a triage-rewritten question, and this file exists to detect the rewrite degrading retrieval, which an end-to-end score can hide when better routing offsets worse retrieval.
pooling_caveat: These per-slice figures pool verified and unverified scenarios, which the standing rule (DL-3) forbids for reporting retrieval QUALITY, because it averages a measurement with a guess. It is admissible here for a different purpose: this file is only ever used for a before/after delta on identical ground truth, where a ground-truth error appears on both sides and cancels. What it does NOT do is make a pass mean more than it does, so `composition` below records how much of each slice rests on checked ground truth. Only the conflict slice has any.
